external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A person who uses the grocery loyalty programme, collects points, and spends them on gift cards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.
external_entities.notes: The text does not specify how members authenticate directly.

external_entities.name: member phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone on which the mobile app and its refresh token reside.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
external_entities.notes: Every partner app is given every scope. The partner app receives a client ID and client secret.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A browser used by a member to sign in and approve consent for a partner app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge. A mobile refresh token never expires: every time the app uses it, its expiry slides forward another ninety days.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization code and consent flows, and issues access and refresh tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.notes: Nobody decided an idle timeout for the authorization-server sign-in cookie.

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API that reads and writes the points ledger and supports points redemption.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: The API does not check which client or audience a token was issued for. It checks the signature with a public key downloaded at startup.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
processes.notes: The authorization server signs tokens for the support console with the same key used elsewhere.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.notes: The ledger records which client made each change, and not which member approved it.

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back.
data_flows.data_description: Rewards requests using an access token

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app, causing its refresh token to be deleted from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The browser submits the member's sign-in to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.description: The browser submits the member's consent decision for the listed scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: approves a consent screen that lists the scopes.

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The authorization code stays valid for ten minutes.

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser submits the authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The authorization server accepts any redirect URI that starts with the registered redirect URI.

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: The partner app submits token requests to the authorization server using its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.notes: The client secret is sent in the request body.
data_flows.data_description: Token request containing a client secret

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app shows a member's points using the rewards API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: The support console obtains access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account. It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

data_flows.name: store identities
data_flows.description: The authorization server reads and writes member identity, authorization, token, and consent records.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes balances and points transactions in the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: Redeeming points for a gift card needs only a valid access token that carries the redeem scope.

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes each received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phones
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing members' phones, which are outside the organisation's cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps.

trust_boundaries.name: partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database is confidential because it contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include personal information and credentials.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger is confidential because it contains member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include member-related financial records.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store is confidential because it contains every request and its headers, which may include credentials and personal data.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include request headers and API request records.
